name: Progress
summary: A styled native <progress> bar for a task that moves towards done, with an indeterminate sweep when there is no value.
description: Use progress for work in motion: an upload, a checklist, an import. For a measurement within a known range, such as disk usage, use a meter.

classes.name: v-progress
classes.description: The bar, on a <progress> element. Leave out value for the indeterminate sweep.

states.description: How far along it is, out of max (default 1). Without it the bar is indeterminate.
No value: a band sweeps across the track.

a11y: Give every bar a name with aria-label or aria-labelledby, so screen readers say what is progressing.
The native element already has the progressbar role and reports its value; no ARIA is needed beyond the name.
Text inside <progress> is a fallback only; show the percentage next to the bar if people need to read it.
For a long task, also announce the end (for example with a toast), since value changes are not read out.
